active.title: Seed-robust Senju champion selection
active.problem: A strategy can look strong in one tournament yet fail multi-seed stability, slowing safe autonomous promotion.
active.hypothesis: A bounded multi-candidate league plus unseen holdout selection will produce more stable champions than single-candidate promotion.
active.commercial_bridge: If repeatedly verified, package the stability/quality-control method as evidence of reliable AI operations. This is not market validation by itself.
